note: Each case is a pattern the bootstrap met while building Ultrastable itself, stripped of names. Surfaces are tried in order; the first that works wins.

cases.title: No admin credential for the code host
cases.situation: The org page must go live, but every session reports it has no org-admin credential.

surfaces.name: Signed-in CLI already on the owner's machine
surfaces.result: scopes include org admin; the change applied

cases.lesson: The first route nobody tried worked. The bootstrap now probes the machine's existing sign-in before it opens any owner card.

cases.title: Deploy needs two repository secrets
cases.situation: A worker is ready, but the deploy workflow has no cloud token.

surfaces.name: Cloud connector, script inline
surfaces.result: upload works only with the script inline; a 66 KB script with base64 image failed transcription

surfaces.name: Shrink the asset
surfaces.result: image cut from 32 KB to 8.6 KB; script is now 35 KB

cases.lesson: Fix the size in code. The workflow still waits for the secrets for routine deploys; that is the only identity-bound part.

gate.why: mints a credential only the owner can
gate.probe: HEAD on the social image returns 200 image/png

cases.title: A registration portal answers with an error
cases.situation: The only online route for a filing returns 'resource not available via this channel'.

surfaces.name: Alternate route: paper submission
surfaces.result: documented, but needs the owner in person

cases.reversible: A complete draft packet and a draft e-mail to the registry's helpdesk are committed.

gate.prepared: full packet, click-by-click walkthrough, helpdesk e-mail draft
gate.probe: a receipt id is recorded in the repo

cases.title: The owner is abroad and the process assumes a local address
cases.situation: A program requires a local representative for applicants who live elsewhere.

surfaces.name: Read the rule at its source
Choose an alternate route with no such rule
surfaces.result: a national route exists with no representative requirement

cases.lesson: Compare routes by rule, at the source, before building the packet for the wrong one.

cases.title: The program needs a legal entity that does not exist
cases.situation: A funding form requires a registered company, a company-domain account and a billing account.

surfaces.name: Fill the form as an individual
Use a different program with no entity requirement
surfaces.result: none of the small programs waive it

cases.reversible: Packet answers drafted and validated; banned-term guard passes.

gate.what: Create the entity and billing account
gate.why: legal and financial identity of the owner
gate.probe: the validator lists zero unmet prerequisites

cases.title: The session may not read the repository it needs
cases.situation: An inventory needs facts from a repository outside the session's scope.

surfaces.name: The repo's own boundary manifest
surfaces.result: covers names only, not the facts needed

cases.reversible: The manifest is recorded as the inventory of record; no entries are invented.

gate.what: Attach the repository to the session scope
gate.default: the manifest stays the inventory of record
gate.prepared: the exact list of missing entries
gate.probe: each inventory file exists with a commit id per row

cases.title: A permission check refuses an action
cases.situation: The harness blocks a rule change that was written without its real scope.

surfaces.name: Read the refusal's reason
surfaces.result: the rule's own text was unconditional

surfaces.name: Write the real scope into the rule and try once more

cases.lesson: A refusal is an input. Fix the condition if it is yours; never reword the same action past the same check.
